title: Gaming machine licences
summary: This page provides information about the regulatory framework and available licenses for activities related to gaming machines in NSW.
intro:
In NSW the regulatory framework for gambling, casinos, wagering and lotteries is administered by Liquor & Gaming NSW. This includes compliance and enforcement activities and licensing certain activities.
